task: Harness-first CLI setup: pick the agentic harness first, offer only compatible models (catalog filtering, name-rule validation with override for catalog-less providers), and warn at launch on legacy mismatched profiles.

key_reasoning.reason: Setup wizard (setup.ts, setup-ui.ts), a new shared harness-to-model compatibility abstraction, per-agent predicates (codex, gemini, and a new one for claude), AgentCLI launch validation and possibly profile/config typing. Four or more components, new abstraction, and a new cli -> agents/plugins coupling.

No exact precedent: compatibility today lives in runtime-only per-agent models modules and setup is harness-agnostic. Name-regex heuristics can misclassify routers, setup gets only string ids with no catalog metadata, catalog-less providers (ollama, litellm, manual entry) need an override path, profiles are shared across harnesses, and legacy mismatched profiles must not break. Closest pattern, codex-models.ts predicates plus assertExplicitCodexModelAllowed, does not cover profile-time validation. Moderate risk, no security surface.

About 6-10 source files modified (setup.ts, setup-ui.ts, AgentCLI.ts, codex/gemini/claude models modules, agent metadata, env types or config) plus 2-4 new files (shared compat module, tests) across cli, agents and providers directories.

CLI/UI wizard, service/agent plugin layer, config/profile persistence (possible harness field with legacy profile compatibility), and provider model listing. Persistence schema implications push this to L. Borderline 20->21 total, leaning higher because Component Scope is XL.
